recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait of a male subject in casual attire, seated on a floor, integrated with large-scale distressed typography that overlaps the figure and background.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized initials acting as a structural frame for the subject
Subject's body positioned behind and between large letterforms
Contrast between the warm, soft-lit photography and the gritty, distressed texture of the primary text
Secondary text anchored to the bottom right for balance
coreInvariants: Distressed, weathered texture on the largest typeface
Subject in a relaxed, seated pose
Warm, natural lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, medium shot, seated on a diagonal plane.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, distressed initial 'T' on the left side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large initials on the left, across the subject's face, down to the bottom-right secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper left and right corners to allow the large typography and subject's head to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals (beige shirt, tan background) providing a soft base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo/blue from denim jeans grounding the lower half.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red and yellow in the typography for high visibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text elements against a desaturated, high-key photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain earthy, warm tones in the photo

letterConstructionRules: Primary initials use an ultra-bold slab serif with exaggerated verticality
Surface of primary letters must feature a heavy, speckled 'grunge' or 'weathered' mask
Secondary name text uses a heavy, rounded sans-serif with a black drop shadow
Bottom metadata uses a wide-tracked, clean geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'Y' are elongated to span nearly the full height of the composition
The 'Y' is positioned to overlap the subject's leg

composition.overlap: Behind and in front of subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed slab serif for impact paired with clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for legibility.

avoid: Clean, modern minimalist sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif skeleton of the initials.
Matches the clean, geometric feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a smiling man with 90s-style hair, wearing a light tan button-down shirt and blue jeans, sitting on a sunlit indoor floor near a window. Soft, warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed red slab-serif initials on the left. Overlay a yellow rounded sans-serif name across the middle. Add white, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif text at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the largest text properly distressed with a grit texture?
Does the yellow text have a visible black drop shadow?
Is the bottom-right text significantly tracked out (wide letter spacing)?
Does the subject appear to be 'inside' the typographic layout?

adjustableVariables: Specific font weight of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: A sense of 1990s country-pop commercial art

postGenerationChecks: Check for proper layering of text over the subject's leg.
Verify the 'grit' texture doesn't obscure the letter shapes too much.
Ensure the color palette remains warm and cohesive.
Confirm the bottom text is perfectly horizontal and aligned right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Oversized Distressed Initials + Layered Secondary Text + Wide-Tracked Footer Text
